title: A done Design system step (Tracy Business EmDash 1.7.18, A 13/13) still lists its Passed rules, each with its Measured on line
steps: S1: run the harness test 'Design system done (Tracy Business EmDash 1.7.18)' in packages/web/tracy-harness/test/template-presses.test.mjs.
S2: run the tracy-web test 'Tracy Business EmDash 1.7.18: all eight built-site rules pass' in apps/tracy-web/test/template-design-system-readiness.test.mjs.
expect: S1: the done design-system row has a Passed group with ROLE-1, SCREEN-1, CON-1, UNDO-1, FONT-1, IDENT-1, MODE-1, MODE-2, each with 'Measured on 1.7.18, 2026-10-13, imac'.
S2: the eight built-site rules of 1.7.18 are measured from contracts/1.7.18/design-system-measurement.json, all pass with that stamp, none is Not measured yet.
fence: No stand, no model, no network. Reads the tree's measurement file and mounts RoadToLive on linkedom.
